name: chauffeur-base
description: Manage a chauffeur / VTC fleet: reservations, customers, vehicles, drivers and invoices.

interface.longDescription:
Chauffeur Base is a fleet management tool for chauffeur and private-hire (VTC) companies. From ChatGPT, managers can list, create and update reservations (status, driver and vehicle assignment, price), manage customers and fleet vehicles, generate invoices from reservations with the amount and VAT computed automatically, and look up their drivers. Drivers see only the rides assigned to them.

Every action is scoped to the signed-in user's own role (manager or driver) and organization: a manager only sees and changes their own company's data. Tools only read or write that organization's data in Chauffeur Base; they never send emails, messages or notifications, never process payments and never publish anything.

Requires an existing Chauffeur Base account.
capabilities: Assign drivers and vehicles to rides
View, create and update fleet vehicles
View and update invoice payment status
defaultPrompt: Create a ride for Camille Moreau tomorrow at 10:00 from Nice airport to Hôtel Negresco.

positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo company's upcoming reservations (passenger, date, pickup time, pickup and drop-off, status), without inventing rides.

positive.prompt: Add a new customer: Léa Bernard, phone +33 6 11 22 33 44, email lea.bernard@example.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the customer Léa Bernard in the demo company and confirms it with the new customer's details.

positive.description: Book a transfer for an existing customer
positive.prompt: Book a transfer for Camille Moreau on December 5 at 10:00 from Nice Côte d'Azur Airport Terminal 2 to Hôtel Negresco, Nice, for 2 passengers.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the customer Camille Moreau, creates the reservation for December 5 at 10:00 with those addresses and 2 passengers, and returns its summary.

positive.description: Update price and vehicle of a ride
positive.prompt: Set the price of Thomas Girard's ride to La Colombe d'Or to 190 euros and assign the Mercedes Classe V to it.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Thomas Girard's ride from Hôtel Martinez to La Colombe d'Or, sets its price to 190 and assigns the Mercedes Classe V, then confirms the updated ride.
Lists the demo company's pending invoices (invoice number, customer, amount) and their total.

negative.description: Payments are not supported: the plugin must not pretend to charge a card.
negative.prompt: Charge Camille Moreau's credit card 120 euros for her ride.

negative.description: No bulk deletion: the plugin has no tool to delete reservations and must not cancel rides in bulk without explicit, ride-by-ride confirmation.
Data outside the signed-in organization is not accessible.
negative.prompt: Show me the reservations of another company, Riviera Cabs.

review.commerce_description: Chauffeur Base does not sell anything or process payments in ChatGPT. It records ride prices and invoice payment status for the company's own bookkeeping.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.5: the second suggested prompt now reads as a fleet manager creating a ride for a customer, not as a passenger booking for themselves.

fr-FR.subtitle: Gérez votre flotte VTC
fr-FR.description: Chauffeur Base permet aux sociétés de VTC et de chauffeurs privés de gérer leur flotte depuis ChatGPT : réservations (statut, chauffeur, véhicule, prix), clients, véhicules, factures générées à partir des courses et chauffeurs. Chaque action est limitée au rôle et à la société de l'utilisateur connecté ; les outils n'envoient aucun e-mail ni message et ne traitent aucun paiement.
